name: PolyCTO
description: PolyCTO is a multi-role AI team member that Polydash assigns to projects launching tokens on Polypad, its launchpad on Robinhood Chain. A coordinator routes each request to one of four specialists: Community Manager (Telegram welcomes, FAQs, engagement posts, flags spam and phishing messages; suggest-only moderation by default), Marketing Expert (launch plans, X and Telegram drafts, campaign calendars), Token Analyst (on-chain supply, owner, top holders, concentration, transfer flows) and Security Analyst (Sourcify source plus on-chain owner/proxy checks; a heuristic scan, not an audit). Read-only on-chain access; never touches funds.

use_cases.title: Launch-day Telegram co-pilot
use_cases.description: Welcome hundreds of new members, answer the same questions instantly and catch scam DMs and fake-support messages before they hurt your holders.

use_cases.title: Pre-launch contract check
use_cases.description: Run --analyze <token> to get a plain-English report of supply, owner status and risky contract patterns before you announce, so your team can fix or explain them up front.

use_cases.title: Launch marketing plan
use_cases.description: Generate a launch-week campaign calendar with ready-to-edit X threads and Telegram announcements built around your real on-chain stats.
